cli.toolSentence: Runs in Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe), a new process for each command, starting in the workspace folder. Write PowerShell, not bash. && and || are syntax errors here: use a; if ($?) { b }. No heredocs, export or VAR=x cmd: use $env:VAR='x'; cmd. Use 2>$null, not 2>/dev/null. curl, ls, rm and where are PowerShell aliases with other flags: call curl.exe and where.exe, and use Remove-Item -Recurse -Force. grep, sed and head may not be installed: check with Get-Command. Run a quoted program path as & "C:\path\app.exe". Commands cannot answer prompts: pass -Force or -Confirm:$false. Write files with the edit tools, not > (it writes UTF-16 here).

cli.toolSentence: Runs in bash (login shell) inside WSL (archlinux), a new process for each command, starting in the workspace folder under /mnt/<drive>/. Use bash syntax and Linux paths: C:\a\b is /mnt/c/a/b here (wslpath converts); the file tools take Windows paths. The distribution has its own python3, node and git, not Windows'. Windows environment variables are not passed in. Scripts with CRLF line endings fail in bash. Walking large trees under /mnt/c is slow. Commands cannot answer prompts.
